title: Explicit width pass excludes already-lowerable streamed MMA output tiles
observation: The retained eligible PV Schedule has one fixed d-axis loop with load, MMA, BF16 rounding and output store. The explicit width API refuses loop_domain while manual execution-group edits lower and pass the original Task gate. This is pass applicability, not a missing IR operation, ISA defect or proof that width1 is universally faster.
proposed_change: Admit existing ordinary streamed output stores and FP32-to-FP16/BF16 casts only when every narrow-result consumer is a store in that same fixed MMA loop. Keep state, explicit storage/synchronization/residency, dynamic stops, multiple loops and warp specialization outside. Reuse the backend owner of affine store coverage and all initial/final assessments.
